Int. goods basic p. [EU 16_939_701] is now 16_738_710 in static version and 1_394_899 * 12 => 16_738_788 in dynamic one.
Before August 22, 2026, there was a significant discrepancy, with the dynamic version exceeding the static version by 2,322,399; the error stemmed from the fact that the static version reported demand (as in the EU data), while the dynamic version reported supply.

In structuralData/data_import.ipynb, cell [6] reports Naio 2022 data.
The first column, "Total" contains intermediate use of the rows' products.

16_939_701.18 is the global amount of intermediate consumption; the same column reports the intemediate consumption of sectors 1-65; we use 0-63 cutting off the last sector (Services provided by extraterritorial organisations).

Examples (# in 1-64 range), with propFact 42.25056:

4 Mining and quarrying [chosen because, proportionally, it requires a large number of imports]
67_100.23 at row 0: intermediate inputs of the sector at basic prices, including
 6_161.09 at row 81: use of imported products (of any sector)
the difference is 60_939.14; we have 82.59*42.25056*12 => 41_873.68 (≈ 2/3)

337_295.56 at row 4 col. Total, is the demand of Mining and quarrying intermediate goods by any sector;
we have (month 1) 678.67*42.25056*12 => 344_090.25
The amount of intermediate Mining and quarrying goods imported directly by each sector is not emerging from this table (it is included in the sectorial use of imported products).

Considering the Added Value gross (row 66) 61_205.82, the amount of intermediate goods as output is 67_100.23 + 61_205.82 => 128_306.05; 
we have 155.15*42.25056*12 => 78_662.09 (≈ 2/3 as above)

From Naio: consumptions 12_761.25; gross capital formation 3_949.72; export (outside EU) 10_117.36;	so, final uses, 26_828.33

26_828.33 + 337_295.56 - 128_306.05 => 235_817.84 as an estimate of the global Mining and quarrying imports

In the case of pref 10 rep 10, imports of Mining and quarrying by productive sectors are 563.4*42.25056*12 => 285_647.58, which is consistent with the 2/3 value of production.

Always in the case of pref 10 rep 10, total imports from sectors are 13368.78 (month 1) giving 13368.78*42.25056*12 = > 6_778_061.29

In Naio we have 2_153_475.82 as total imports from sectors
